description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'DrupalImageTextAlternativeUI' that provides a custom UI for managing image alternative text within a Drupal-specific context. It includes methods for creating UI components such as buttons, forms, and missing alt text indicators, and handles interactions like showing/hiding a balloon panel for editing alt text.

classes.name: DrupalImageAlternativeTextUi
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that provides a UI for managing image alternative text, including a button, form, and missing alt text indicator, with logic for showing/hiding a balloon panel.

methods.name: requires
methods.description: Returns the required plugins, specifically ContextualBalloon.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by creating UI components and setting up event handlers for image insertion and upload completion.

methods.name: _createMissingAltTextComponent
methods.description: Creates a UI component to display a message when an image is missing alt text, with a button to show the alt text form.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys UI components when the plugin is destroyed.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a button in the UI to open the alt text editing balloon.

methods.name: _createForm
methods.description: Creates the form view for editing alt text, sets up event handlers for submit, cancel, repositioning, and outside clicks.

methods.name: _showForm
methods.description: Displays the alt text form in a balloon panel, synchronizing its state with the current command value.

methods.name: _hideForm
methods.description: Hides the balloon panel containing the form, optionally refocusing the editor.

methods.name: _isVisible
methods.description: Getter that returns true if the form is currently visible in the balloon.

methods.name: _isInBalloon
methods.description: Getter that returns true if the form is currently added to the balloon.
